## Covariates to FG + Size Model

Previously, in `covars_correlation.qmd` we looked at the correlation between environmental covariates of the sites and the interaction coefficient from the Species + Size model.

As we are going with the FG + Size model now, we can look at the correlation between environmental covariates and the FG + Size model.

Load in the FG + Size Model

```{r}
fg_size <- read.csv("scripts/model_specifications/fg_size/fg_size_df_t15_updated.csv")
```

\
Load in site covariates as well:

```{r}
#Load site covariates 
site_covars <- read.csv("../../data/site_covariates.csv")
```
